notes.title: [v1.07] NEW LEVEL! Plus minor updates and bug fix
notes.content:
Here's what's changed:
[list]
[*] Added a BRAND NEW level: Dawnpipes. It’s the second level of the game, after Launchtube.
[*] Set in Earth’s upper atmosphere, Dawnpipes has a day/night cycle and is designed for high speed ramping and racing through curved pipes!
[*] Changed the order of the levels.
[*] Fixed a “return to main menu” bug that happened after the Launchtube level.
[*] When you open the HUD with the Tab key, you’ll be greeted by a new circuitboard texture :)
[/list]

notes.title: v1.05 Major Update! New BASICs level with day/night cycle
notes.content:
Greetings from Mars!

Check out the all new BASICs level by starting a New Game, or selecting it from the Level Select menu. It has a very cool day/night cycle (Spare Parts, too).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43094631/2e5cbce4584f3ca08e7c75ed5a5c76c6c422cdaa.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43094631/7f520d24c144a90a541c5bd7671e8c1af3151ab1.jpg[/img]

Launchtube has some minor tweaks too, mostly to the graphics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43094631/d5d59c0af3121016c964eee6e14e318e4a85dcfc.jpg[/img]

Lots of other small changes, like the loading screens and main menu.

Stay tuned for new levels, level overhauls, and more!

notes.title: Major Update Coming Soon!!!
notes.content:
Greetings, Hyper Runners!

Work on Space Cheetah continues after the festive season break ːsteamhappyː

Here's what to expect in a series of updates over the next few weeks:
[list]
[*] Day/night cycles in certain levels.
[*] New levels!
[*] New 3D models and textures.
[*] Tweaks and improvements to existing levels.
[*] A brand new BASICs tutorial level. It's so, so much better.
[/list]

Stay tuned - 2023 - the year of the Space Cheetah. ːsteamthumbsupː
Best wishes,
Matt

notes.title: Pre-launch Patch
notes.content:
Thanks to all the amazing Space Cheetah play testers!

Your feedback has been invaluable.

The latest patch addresses the following:
[list]
[*] Changed the order of the levels.
[*] Added more signage in the levels. The levels are designed as sandboxes, but you shouldn't ever be (totally) lost!
[*] Added more Level Exit pointer hand signs. Obviously, you shouldn't be scratching your head to find the exit!
[/list]
Thanks again, and continue racing your space cheetahs across the Martian dustbowl!
